# Synthetic regression fixtures

These files contain no user media or private data. The orange/cream PNG and circle SVG are generated shapes. The MP4 is one second of FFmpeg's generated test pattern plus a sine wave, and the WAV is a one-second synthetic tone. Office fixtures contain one synthetic paragraph, slide or worksheet. The PDF has three labeled pages; `form.pdf` adds a synthetic text form field for flattening checks. Structured and markup examples exercise quoted cells, additional columns, and inert script text.
